name: Westlake
description: Westlake makes the building blocks of PVC plastic and then sells the finished products. In its chemicals segment it turns ethane into ethylene and salt plus electricity into chlorine and caustic soda, and makes PVC, polyethylene and epoxy resins from them; those commodity prices swing with global supply and demand. In its housing and infrastructure segment it converts its own PVC into siding, trim, stone veneer, roofing, windows, decking, and water and sewer pipe. The two halves behaved very differently in 2025: building products earned $587 million of operating income, while the chemicals segment lost $2.1 billion after $727 million of impairments and $624 million of restructuring charges tied to plant closures. Total 2025 net loss attributable to Westlake was $1.5 billion on $11.2 billion of sales.

businessLines.description: Ethylene, polyethylene (LDPE, LLDPE), chlor-alkali (chlorine, caustic soda), chlorinated derivatives, EDC/VCM, PVC and epoxy resins. About 39.2 billion pounds per year of aggregate capacity in North America, Europe and Asia.
